title: Print Window Row Column Border Alignment
description: Make SemioWindowRowTwo/Three stretch every window in a row to the tallest sibling height (bottom borders align). Add SemioWindowColumnTwo/Three symmetric primitive for right-border alignment. Add anchor key (nw, n, ne, w, center, e, sw, s, se) for content positioning within stretched boxes. Apply anchor=center to cover logo windows.
summary: Implemented composable window row/column border alignment in print LaTeX. SemioWindowRowTwo/Three now measure column heights and stretch every child Window to the tallest sibling via tcolorbox height= so bottom borders align while tops stay flush. Added SemioWindowColumnTwo/Three symmetric primitive: measure natural widths with fit mode, stretch to widest sibling width for right-border alignment, stack with block sep. Added anchor key (nw/n/ne/w/center/e/sw/s/se) mapping to tcolorbox valign/halign, plus fit key for content-sized windows. Cover logo row in makecoverpages uses anchor=center. Verified mit-bestand zwischenbericht build and ticket bisect/rasterize fixtures.
